properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.17.14 declared in Cargo.lock (rustls backend for HTTPS RPC transports). X25519 key agreement is available in the shipped dependency tree; any TLS 1.2/1.3 session it negotiates is harvest-now-decrypt-later material. No first-party X25519 call site in application code. ring as a provider is also filed by scout 1 (LIB-6c059504). Migration is the TLS stack's hybrid groups (X25519MLKEM768) once the pinned runtime negotiates them — changeable here via dependency upgrade.

No first-party Ed25519 call site found — available in the shipped library; PQ capability of the TLS stack is decided by this provider choice (ring: no ML-KEM hybrid).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-GCM (aes-gcm crate) is the AEAD of the tempo zone deposit ECIES: encrypt_deposit seals the recipient/memo plaintext to the sequencer's key with a random 96-bit nonce (crates/cast/src/cmd/tempo/zone/encryption.rs:54; the :106/:120 sites are the roundtrip test). Symmetric, Grover leaves a 128-bit margin — PQ-adequate as-is; the quantum exposure of this ECIES is its ECDH input, filed separately.

properties.name: pqs:context

KDF is symmetric — PQ-adequate; its secrecy inherits the Shor-vulnerable secp256k1 ECDH input (filed as a separate finding at the same file). hardcoded salt noted: b"ecies-aes-key".
